metod-1: two separate round glass discs lying side by side on a thin frosted glass tile with a clear gap between them, not touching and not overlapping: one disc glows warm orange, the other is clear blue glass.
metod-2: a tall glass thermometer standing upright next to a thick glass bar split into two pieces slightly pulled apart: a short piece glowing warm orange and a long piece of clear blue glass.
metod-3: a long horizontal glass ruler bar with evenly spaced small round glass beads along it; one short segment between two neighbouring tall glass markers glows warm orange, the rest of the bar is clear blue glass.
metod-4: two thick round glass lenses partly overlapping each other like a Venn diagram, lying on a frosted glass tile; the lens-shaped overlapping part glows warm orange, the rest is clear blue glass.
metod-5: a 6 by 6 grid of small square glass tiles on a frosted glass plate; the last row and the last column of tiles are pushed down and dimmed, the remaining 5 by 5 block is clear blue glass and a few of its tiles glow warm orange; one realistic white die with dark pips stands beside the plate.
metod-6: a short chain of three linked glass rings lying in a gentle curve, each ring glowing a little warmer than the previous one, the last ring glowing warm orange.
metod-7: three small glass light bulbs in a row on a glass stand: two are dark clear blue glass and one glows bright warm orange.
metod-8: a small glass bowl with several glass marbles, two of them lifted out and floating above it one after another: one blue glass marble and one marble glowing warm orange, with a faint glowing curved arrow between them.
metod-9: a small branching tree made of glass rods: one trunk splits into two branches and each branch splits into two twigs ending in small glass spheres; two of the end spheres on different branches glow warm orange.
metod-10: a row of four glass arrows stuck in a round glass archery target: three arrows near the edge are clear blue glass and the fourth arrow in the centre glows warm orange.
primer-1a: a mighty oak tree made of blue glass with a realistic golden chain wound around its trunk, and an open old book with blank pages lying at its roots.
primer-1b: a wooden door made of blue glass standing slightly ajar, a small dovecote made of glass beside it with one realistic white dove on its roof, and a realistic school slate with a piece of chalk leaning against the door.
primer-2a: a primitive umbrella made of blue glass with a realistic green parrot perched on its handle, next to a wooden post with notches made of glass.
primer-2b: an old leather doctor's bag standing open with a long glass thermometer sticking out of it, and a small blue glass hippopotamus figurine beside the bag.
primer-3a: a realistic small golden key lying on an open school exercise book made of blue glass, next to a glass inkwell with a goose quill.
primer-3b: a blacksmith's anvil made of blue glass with a realistic iron horseshoe on it, a small hammer leaning against it, and a pair of realistic red embroidered women's slippers next to the anvil.
primer-4a: two small glass samovars side by side, several small glass teacups on saucers around them, and one realistic shiny copper coin lying in front of them.
primer-4b: a realistic round golden-brown bun lying on a small glass weighing scale with two pans, a glass rolling pin beside the scale.
primer-5a: a small picket fence made of blue glass, half of the planks painted realistic white, a realistic bucket of white paint with a brush, and two realistic white dice with dark pips lying in front of the fence.
primer-5b: a realistic wide-brimmed musketeer hat with a long white feather lying on a small blue glass tavern table, a blue glass dice cup lying on its side and two realistic white dice with dark pips rolling out of it.
primer-6a: a glass chessboard with a few blue glass chess pieces and one realistic dark queen chess piece standing on it, and a tall oval looking-glass mirror made of glass standing behind the board.
primer-6b: a longbow made of blue glass lying in front of four small round glass archery targets standing in a row, three realistic arrows with green fletching stuck in three of the targets.
primer-7a: three small glass oil lamps in the shape of classic oriental genie lamps, each with a small warm flame, standing on a heap of realistic gold coins and jewels.
primer-7b: three pointed old Russian warrior helmets made of blue glass standing in a row, a realistic wooden longbow and three arrows lying in front of them, and a small round glass target with one arrow in it.
primer-8a: a wicker basket made of blue glass holding six realistic golden-brown baked pies, and a small realistic clay pot of butter next to the basket.
primer-8b: a painter's palette made of blue glass with blobs of realistic paint, several realistic metal paint tubes in blue, red and green lying around it, and a slim brush.
primer-9a: a large rough boulder made of blue glass standing at a fork of two paths, a realistic old Russian knight's pointed steel helmet and a straight sword lying in front of the boulder.
primer-9b: a realistic painted tin toy soldier with a red coat and a rifle standing on one leg, next to a small blue glass figurine of a ballerina and an open glass toy box.
primer-10a: a crossbow made of blue glass and a realistic red apple pierced by a short crossbow bolt lying in front of it.
primer-10b: a fishing net made of blue glass threads spread on the ground, an old cracked wooden trough beside it, and a realistic golden fish leaping above the net.
